description: This Java class 'DocumentService' acts as a service layer in a receipt and expense management platform. It handles document uploads, versioning, OCR text extraction, categorization, search, and administrative statistics. It relies on external services like OCR and categorization, and interacts with a document repository for persistence.

classes.name: DocumentService
classes.description: A Spring Service class that manages documents, including uploading, versioning, OCR processing, categorization, searching, and stats.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a new document, performs OCR and categorization, and initializes document versioning.

methods.name: addVersion
methods.description: Adds a new version to an existing document with OCR text extraction and categorization.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for documents based on query, category, and user ID filters.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets or updates the category of a document and its latest version.

methods.name: adminStats
methods.description: Provides aggregated statistics about stored documents, categorized and per user.
